comment: Website Crafter's Quality, Speed and Consumption config for a website repo, from Git Crafter's starter (templates/quality/config.json at v7.1.0). Copy it to quality/config.json and set name. It keeps the six tabs a site repo can measure in CI, pages first: deploys, design, usability and page speed of the live site. It leaves out documentation, whose docs.unmapped gate fails a pull request until every doc is mapped, and the tabs that read an admin token or a project board (discussions, projects, security, scanning, insights, settings). Add any back by id. Edit targets/web.json for your site and copy it to quality/targets/. packs loads Website Crafter's pack at one full commit SHA, the four Process maps the process starter uses: it adds no tab. A tag or a branch is refused, because a pack runs in CI. Keys: Git Crafter quality/CONFIG.md.
name: my-site
